# foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# The "Library" environment is the root of every organization's lifecycle path
data "foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment" "library" {
  name = "Library"
}

resource "foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment" "dev" {
  name            = "Development"
  description     = "Development lifecycle environment"
  label           = "development"
  organization_id = 1

  prior_id = tonumber(data.foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment.library.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `library` (Boolean)
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `prior_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `successor_id` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment.dev <lifecycle_environment_id>
```
